environment.network: local Atoll websocket/HTTP and daemon File Resource only; no third-party website

correctness: all 50 immutable File Resources retained their exact SHA-256 after execution
all 50 imports reached previewed before public confirmation and completed after bounded apply
exactly 1000 Companies and 1000 succeeded import items were materialized
all 1100 Work business rows were unique and all 100 Attempts succeeded
all four configured Executor actors accepted successful Attempts
each successful Attempt produced one work wake and one capacity-release wake, and all 200 dispatches were delivered
every delivered Recruiting MySQL domain event ID was found in the Atoll Channel ledger
after Server restart the user logged in, the first create command returned its original previewing receipt, and its File Resource remained readable

scope.proved: real local Server, daemon, four same-class Executors, File Resource, MySQL, dispatch outbox, and Channel ledger can complete and recover a deterministic 1000-row control/data-plane workload
scope.not_proved: HTTP/Browser website execution throughput, response Artifact write throughput, remote Resource providers, 20K daily Listing plus 400K Detail completion, long-window saturation, or production SLO

acceptance.reason: the first real-process ledger/Resource/Executor baseline is reproducible, but it deliberately does not stand in for external fetch and response Artifact throughput
